description: Compact action shown as an icon, with a required accessible name.

howToUse: Use it for a frequent action that a known icon already says: close, edit, delete, more options.
Always pass `aria-label` with the action ("Delete invoice"); it is what a screen reader announces.
Put it next to what it acts on, such as the end of a row or the corner of a card.
Pair it with Tooltip when the icon is not obvious to everyone.
alternatives: The icon alone does not say the action: Button with text, with `leadingIcon` if you want the icon.
Main floating action on mobile: Fab.

keyboard.action: Moves focus to the button. A disabled button is skipped.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Required accessible label: the button has no visible text.
